_comment: Week 6 evaluation test set. Each case pairs a résumé fixture with an explicit relevance rubric the LLM judge applies to every job the agent surfaced. The rubric is deliberately independent of the agent's own 0-10 scoring prompt so the judge is not grading with the same instrument.

cases.profile: Senior Python backend engineer (FastAPI/Django, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes)
cases.relevant: Backend, platform, or full-stack roles where Python server-side work is central; senior/lead level acceptable down to mid-level. API, microservices, or infrastructure-adjacent backend roles count.
cases.not_relevant: Frontend-only roles, data-science roles, roles centred on a different backend stack with no Python (e.g. pure Java/.NET), non-engineering roles, junior/intern-only roles.

cases.profile: Senior frontend engineer (React, TypeScript, Next.js, accessibility)
cases.relevant: Frontend or full-stack-leaning-frontend roles using React or an adjacent modern JS framework; senior or mid level.
cases.not_relevant: Backend-only, mobile-native-only, designer-only roles, WordPress/site-builder gigs, non-engineering roles.

cases.profile: Data analyst (SQL, Tableau/Power BI, A/B testing)
cases.relevant: Data analyst, analytics, BI, or reporting roles centred on SQL and dashboards/experimentation; business-facing analytics counts.
cases.not_relevant: Data engineering or ML engineering roles requiring heavy software engineering, pure data-entry roles, marketing roles without an analytics core, non-data roles.

cases.relevant: SRE, DevOps, platform, cloud, or infrastructure engineering roles; on-call/reliability or IaC-centred roles count.
cases.not_relevant: Pure application development roles, IT helpdesk/support, security-only roles, non-engineering roles.

cases.relevant: Machine learning, LLM/AI engineering, MLOps, or applied data-science roles where building/deploying models is central.
cases.not_relevant: Pure data-analyst roles (SQL/BI only), general backend roles with no ML component, AI product-manager or sales roles, annotation/labeling gigs.

cases.relevant: iOS, Android, cross-platform (React Native/Flutter acceptable), or mobile-leading full-stack roles; senior or mid level.
cases.not_relevant: Web-frontend-only roles, backend-only roles, QA-only roles, non-engineering roles.

cases.profile: Security engineer (AppSec, cloud security, incident response)
cases.relevant: Security engineering, application security, cloud security, DevSecOps, or security-analyst roles.
cases.not_relevant: General SWE/DevOps roles with no security focus, physical-security roles, compliance-only paperwork roles with no technical component, non-engineering roles.

cases.profile: Data engineer (Spark, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake/BigQuery, Kafka)
cases.relevant: Data engineering, analytics engineering, or data-platform roles centred on pipelines, warehousing, or streaming.
cases.not_relevant: Pure BI/analyst roles with no pipeline building, ML-research roles, general backend roles with no data-pipeline component, non-engineering roles.

cases.profile: QA automation engineer / SDET (Playwright, Selenium, Cypress)
cases.relevant: QA automation, SDET, or test-engineering roles; QA roles that mix manual + automation count if automation is present.
cases.not_relevant: Purely manual QA roles with no automation, developer roles with no testing focus, customer support, non-engineering roles.

cases.profile: Senior product manager (B2B SaaS, developer/data products)
cases.relevant: Product manager or product owner roles in software, ideally B2B/SaaS/technical products; senior or mid level.
cases.not_relevant: Project-manager/scrum-master roles, engineering roles, marketing or sales roles, non-software product roles.

cases.profile: Technical writer (developer docs, API reference, docs-as-code)
cases.relevant: Technical writing, documentation engineering, or developer-education/content roles about software products.
cases.not_relevant: Marketing copywriting, generic content-writer/SEO roles, engineering roles, editor roles for non-technical content.

cases.profile: EDGE CASE — junior web developer, career changer from teaching (thin signal)
cases.relevant: Junior or entry-level web development roles, WordPress/site-maintenance roles, internships or apprenticeship-style dev roles; ed-tech dev roles are a plus.
cases.not_relevant: Senior/staff engineering roles, roles requiring 3+ years professional dev experience, teaching roles with no development component, non-engineering roles.
